load_beit_model: load a pretrained BEiT base or large model from the model_dict using __model_loader__
build_vision_transformer: build a VisionTransformer with configurable patch size, depth, and number of attention heads
create_beit_base_224: create a BEiT base model with 768 embed dim, 12 layers, and 224x224 input size
create_beit_large_384: create a BEiT large model with 1024 embed dim, 24 layers, and 384x384 input size
run_patch_embedding: run the PatchEmbed module to convert an image tensor into a sequence of patch embeddings
